messages:
devin_ap: Vendor "Blue Ridge Solutions" sent invoice and attached a W-8BEN-E but their bank and contact are US-based. They also asked us to "gross-up" for any withholding. Thoughts?

mike_taxes: Gross-up requests = commercial ask, not tax requirement. If vendor is US person they should give a W-9. W-8 + US bank/address is suspicious. Need clarification and docs.

sarah_ledger: Invoice snippet: `BR-2026-77, USD 8,200, Attached: W-8BEN-E, Note: please process net`

julia_vendor_relations: I messaged them to confirm entity status and asked for either a W-9 or substantiation for W-8 (owner passport + foreign tax residency cert). Also offered faster payment terms if they need cashflow.

taxbot: Internal: if W-8 is valid and payee is foreign, withholding may be reduced by treaty; if invalid or they are US person, we need W-9 and no withholding (unless backup withholding applies). Backup withholding can be applied if TIN missing/mismatch.

mike_taxes: Action: AP holds payment. Do not gross-up. Request vendor provides W-9 or validated W-8 evidence. If vendor insists on gross-up, escalate to legal/procurement for commercial resolution.

devin_ap: Put AP hold in NetSuite and notified accounting. Not releasing until docs fixed.

sarah_ledger: Vendor replied: "we're a US LLC but owner is foreign; will send passport and owner SSN". Asked vendor to provide W-9 ASAP.

mike_taxes: OK. Wait for W-9. If they provide passport + foreign owner docs instead of W-9, route to tax counsel. No gross-up.

julia_vendor_relations: I'll push for W-9 and offer Net15 if they sign waiver. Will update here.
